text: Hello stranger!
zh: 你好，陌生人！

text:
You again.
What do you need?
zh:
又是你。
你需要什么？

text: This is a caravan from Icefall Village, and I am their leader.
zh: 这是来自冰瀑村的商队，我是他们的领队。

text: You may call me #:Glen:#.
zh: 你可以叫我#:格伦:#。

text: Where do you come from?
zh: 你们从哪儿来？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你们在这里做什么？

text: Why did you leave the village?
zh: 你们为什么离开村子？

text: I found this letter nearby.
zh: 我在附近捡到了这封信。

text: Do you sell any wares?
zh: 你们卖货吗？

text: I heard, you were selling a permit for the capital.
zh: 听说你在卖进入王都的通行证。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: We are a caravan of the Icefall Village as I've mentioned.
zh: 正如我说过的，我们是冰瀑村的商队。

text: It lies way to the east, behind the Ice Passage.
zh: 村子远在东边，在寒冰通道的另一头。

text: As it is frozen at the moment, it seems like we are stranded here for now.
zh: 通道目前封冻着，看来我们暂时被困在这里了。

text: The elders of the village talk about another passage, but this knowledge seems to not be of any use at the moment.
zh: 村里的长者提起过另一条通道，但这条消息眼下似乎派不上用场。

text: Currently, we are waiting for the passage to thaw, so we may return home.
zh: 现在我们只能等通道解冻，好返回家乡。

text:
It is my duty to return everyone belonging to this caravan back safely.
They have chosen to put their faith into me, after all.
zh:
把商队的每一个人平安带回去是我的职责。
毕竟，他们选择了信任我。

text: The Icefall residents send out caravans in order to trade wares with the capital.
zh: 冰瀑村的居民派出商队，与王都互通贸易。

text: East of the Ice Passage, there's plenty of resources the capital is in need of.
zh: 寒冰通道以东有许多王都急需的资源。

text: Some of the other people tend to join us during our travels, as they want to see other parts of the world.
zh: 也有些人会在旅途中加入我们，想看看外面的世界。

text: However, I might have already failed on that front.
zh: 不过，在这一点上，我恐怕已经失职了。

text: Before the bridge broke down, Lennard wanted to trade wares with the bandits.
zh: 桥塌之前，伦纳德想和强盗们做买卖。

text: He did not return, and many are too afraid to make their way up to them.
zh: 他一去不回，而大家多半都不敢上去找他们。

text: Have a warm and pleasant day!
zh: 祝你有温暖愉快的一天！

text: That's why we are here!
zh: 这正是我们来这里的原因！

text:
Either way, you would be correct.
There's one I could spare.
zh:
不管怎么说，你没听错。
我确实有一张可以出手。

text: For saving Lennard, I think you deserve it as recompense. It is the very least I could do.
zh: 你救了伦纳德，我想这就当作报答，你受之无愧。这是我起码能做的。

text: However, a permit is rather expensive, you know?
zh: 不过，通行证可是相当昂贵的，你知道吗？

text: You can have this one for around... 4000 gold.
zh: 这张就……4000金币让给你吧。

text: Alright. (give 4000 gold)
That's way too much.
zh: 这也太贵了。

text: Permits do not sell quickly. You may return if you change your mind.
zh: 通行证一时半会儿也卖不出去。你要是改了主意，随时可以回来。

text: There you go. If the guards ask, you did not get this from me, alright?
zh: 给你。要是卫兵问起，这可不是从我这儿拿的，明白吗？

text: A letter?
zh: 一封信？

text: Looks like this letter was signed by a Gregor.
zh: 看来这封信的署名是一个叫格雷戈的人。

text: He is a scholar of the #:academy:#, if I remember correctly.
zh: 如果我没记错，他是#:学院:#的一位学者。

text: A few days ago he bought some rations. I haven't seen him since.
zh: 几天前他买了些干粮。从那以后我就没再见过他。
